name: OpenHuman
description: Runs an open-source agent harness with a Rust core as a desktop app, browser UI, terminal client or embeddable library, with pluggable models, memory, search and workflows.

skills.name: Agent-Drafted Workflows
skills.description: Builds saved, typed automation graphs on the tinyflows engine with 22 node kinds; the agent drafts the graph and you review it on a canvas.

skills.name: Memory v2
skills.description: Provides Recall, Fetch and Store over a pluggable engine, either hosted TinyHumans CortexDB or your own CortexDB endpoint and key.

skills.name: Rust Embedding Library
skills.description: Embeds the core in another Rust process via openhuman-embed, running agents with their own provider, access tier, MCP servers and skills.
